verdict.rationale: Mistral's docs describe an Organization usage dashboard and mention 'Workspace caps or API limits' that admins can adjust after reviewing spend, implying some budget-control mechanism exists, but the evidence never shows a self-service way to set a hard spending cap, budget alert, or automatic cutoff to stop a runaway workload. Missing for 10: documented alerting/notification system, ability to set a hard dollar cap enforced automatically, and any hands-on/independent confirmation these caps actually block overspend.
